=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:113, 121-122 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cancellation safeguard treats a check name specially only when it matches `_pr_auto_merge_required_ci_check_name`. When `AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK=none`, that function returns `none`, so a cancelled required `lint` run uses generic name-only supersession.
  WHY: The required-check list is resolved independently by `_pr_required_check_names_for_base` and can still require `lint`. On an unprotected branch with `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS=lint`, a cancelled CI `lint` followed by a successful `lint` from another workflow is treated as passing; `_pr_checks_completed` can then authorize a merge without successful CI.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_summarize_final_merge_blockers | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The summary calls `_pr_auto_merge_required_ci_check_name` to resolve the CI check name for the supersession rules, but this function is not defined in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` (the diff adds no such function, and the library defines `_pr_required_check_names_for_base` instead). When the function is absent, `summary_ci_name` stays `"none"`, the CI-name branch of `PR_CHECKS_JQ_SUPERSEDE_DEFS` is skipped (`$ci != "none"` is false), and the summary falls back to plain name-only supersession. That is more permissive than the gate: a cancelled `lint` superseded by a newer `lint` from an unrelated workflow (for example `lint-pr-body-auto-close.yml` re-running on a PR body edit) is dropped from the alert text even though the gate would still block on it. The alert then posts `Blocking check-runs: unknown — see PR check-runs`, which is misleading when the gate's actual blocker is visible in the check-runs.
  WHY: The gate refuses a merge because a cancelled required `lint` is not superseded (no same-run re-run, no bound CI run). The summary, using name-only supersession, marks that cancelled `lint` as superseded by the newer unrelated `lint` and returns an empty blocker list. The alert body omits the real blocker.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
